dedupe_keys.name: national population commission nigeria enumeration area demarcation ead geodatabase for the 2023 census 598 988 enumeration areas with building points important features roads drainage and railway on request

description: Nigeria's National Population Commission demarcated the whole country into enumeration areas for the planned 2023 Population and Housing Census and published a 97 page data dictionary of the resulting geospatial datasets. The ArcGIS file geodatabase holds 598,988 enumeration areas covering 774 Local Government Areas of the 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, with supervisory areas, localities, wards and LGAs. It also has a point for every building recorded in the field with its type, points of interest, and road, drainage and railway lines extracted from satellite imagery, plus household counts by area. Fieldwork ran from November 2014 to April 2022, first on paper and then on tablets with the Commission's EADPad tool. Coverage is national, except that some insecure areas were mapped as hybrid enumeration areas. Format and access: the metadata and a report are free PDFs; the data themselves are not downloadable, and requests go to the Commission's Chairman, with selected enumeration areas released by purpose. Licence: use is limited to the requested purpose with no sharing to third parties. Caveats: no 2023 census results were published on the pages read, so there are no census counts; the building points are a census frame, not a cadastre. Simulation uses: a national building and road layer for exposure, accessibility and emergency planning where open footprints lack attributes. Related records: the GRID3 Nigeria health facilities and the WorldPop GRID3 census based gridded population.
